Chính sách CSBH 4.2 (từ 17/10/2026) trừ: Sales policy CSBH 4.2 (from October 17, 2026) deducts successively from the price excl. VAT & maintenance fee: first the Nha Xinh furniture gift (Studio 35 million, 1BR/1BR+ 50 million, 2BR 75 million, 3BR 100 million VND), then 3% if you do not take a loan, 1% if you decline the bank guarantee (optional), and finally early payment of 2.5% (50%) / 5% (70%) / 12% (95%) for units booked before October 26, 2026 (limited quantity). Combined, discounts reach about 15.5%, excluding the gift. Note that the early payment incentive does not come with the interest rate support package.
